title: V-partitions and Unimodal Sequences
key_idea: A **V-partition** of $n$ with parts in $\{1,\ldots,m\}$ is a sequence $(\lambda_1, \ldots, \lambda_k)$ that is first decreasing then increasing (a 'V'-shape). Counting these via I-E connects to unimodal sequences and certain $q$-series identities.
